{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high, especially in early horizons, showing negative forecast bias that corrects as prediction range extends",
    "True outcomes exhibit steady downward drift relative to current levels, revealing mean-reversion bias in both model and sentiment-based forecasts",
    "Sentiment signals have minimal explanatory power for price movements, with bullish sentiment frequently aligning with price declines",
    "Forecast deterioration accelerates after day 15 in both model and true outcomes, with divergences expanding from ~1-2 unit differences to 3-5+ units",
    "Price momentum decays rapidly - 1-2 day lag exists between price changes and forecast incorporation, causing forecasts to trail reality",
    "Sentiment turning points correlate poorly with actual price inflection points, suggesting delayed or distorted market sentiment processing",
    "Model overfits recent price levels while failing to capture underlying mean-reversion dynamics, producing forecasts that are 2-5% too high for first 30 days"
] }
